transcribed: read from the Cadetprep Excel sheet by extract-cadetprep.ts (sheet row = n); key and solution are the source's, kept as evidence

questions.stem: In a company, \(35\)% of the employees are women. What percentage of the employees are men?
The percentage of boys in a class is \(60\)%. What is the percentage of girls?
If \(45\)% of a population is under \(18\) years of age, what percentage is \(18\) years or older?
In a survey, \(62\)% liked product A, \(25\)% liked product B and the rest were indifferent. What percentage were indifferent?
In an office, \(48\)% of the employees work in Sales and \(32\)% in Marketing. The rest are in Administration. What percentage of employees are in Administration?
A school has \(1200\) students. If \(45\)% are in primary and \(35\)% in secondary, how many students are in senior secondary?
In a factory, \(65\)% workers are skilled and \(20\)% are semi-skilled. What percentage are unskilled?
A survey records operating-system usage: Android \(38\)%, iOS \(27\)%, Windows \(15\)% and the rest Other OS. What percentage use Other OS?
In a city, \(42\)% of the population lives in apartments and \(33\)% in independent houses. The remainder lives elsewhere. What percentage is this remainder?
A library has \(8000\) books: \(35\)% fiction, \(25\)% non-fiction, \(20\)% textbooks and the rest reference books. How many reference books are there?
In an election, candidate A secured \(45\)% votes and candidate B secured \(32\)% votes. What percentage of votes were invalid?
A budget allocates: Defence \(28\)%, Education \(22\)%, Healthcare \(18\)%, Infrastructure \(20\)% and the rest to Others. What percentage is allotted to Others?
In a college, \(56\)% students are under-graduates and \(31\)% post-graduates. What percentage are research scholars?
A company’s revenue comes from Product sales \(68\)%, Services \(22\)% and Licensing. What percentage comes from Licensing?
A park occupies: Gardens \(40\)%, Playgrounds \(25\)%, Parking \(15\)% and the remaining area is Walkways. What percentage of the park is Walkways?
At a restaurant, \(47\)% of customers prefer vegetarian food, \(38\)% prefer non-vegetarian and the rest prefer both. What percentage prefer both?
A mall has shops as follows: Clothes \(32\)%, Electronics \(18\)%, Food \(15\)%, Accessories \(20\)% and the rest Books. What percentage of shops sell Books?
A transport survey shows: Cars \(44\)%, Public transport \(28\)%, Bikes \(18\)% and the rest Walk. What percentage of people walk?
At a university, \(38\)% students study Science, \(29\)% study Arts, \(21\)% study Commerce, and the rest study Engineering. What percentage study Engineering?
Hospital staff composition: Doctors \(35\)%, Nurses \(45\)%, Technicians \(12\)% and the rest Administrative staff. What percentage are Administrative staff?
A market survey shows preferences: Brand A \(26\)%, Brand B \(22\)%, Brand C \(19\)%, Brand D \(18\)% and the rest No-preference. What percentage have no preference?
A country’s energy mix is Coal \(42\)%, Oil \(28\)%, Gas \(15\)%, Nuclear \(8\)% and Renewable. What percentage is Renewable energy?
In a city, males constitute \(52\)% of the population. If there are \(260000\) males, what is the total population?
A company’s expenses: Salaries \(45\)%, Rent \(15\)%, Utilities \(8\)%, Marketing \(12\)% and Others \(20\)% equal \(\,40000\). What is the total expense?
In a sports club, \(34\)% of members play cricket, \(28\)% football, \(22\)% tennis and the rest badminton. What percentage play badminton?
Store sales distribution: Electronics \(36\)%, Clothing \(24\)%, Books \(18\)%, Toys \(14\)% and the remainder Groceries. What percentage of sales are Groceries?
In a class of \(40\) students, \(60\)% are girls. How many boys are there?
A family budget allocates: Food \(35\)%, Housing \(25\)%, Transport \(15\)%, Healthcare \(10\)%, Education \(8\)% and Savings. What percentage goes to Savings?
In a concert audience, \(42\)% like classical music, \(31\)% like rock, \(19\)% like jazz and the rest like pop. What percentage like pop?
A factory produces Cars \(48\)%, Trucks \(32\)% and Motorcycles \(20\)%. If \(960\) cars are produced, what is the total production?
In a library membership, \(37\)% are students, \(28\)% professionals, \(21\)% retirees and the rest others. What percentage are others?
TV channel viewership distribution: News \(29\)%, Entertainment \(35\)%, Sports \(24\)% and the rest Documentaries. What percentage watch Documentaries?
Park visitors: Jogging \(33\)%, Walking \(28\)%, Cycling \(22\)%, Yoga \(9\)% and the rest Picnic. What percentage come for Picnic?
Mobile-app usage: Social \(41\)%, Games \(23\)%, Shopping \(16\)%, News \(12\)% and the rest Others. What percentage is Others?
Breakfast preferences: Bread \(38\)%, Cereal \(29\)%, Fruits \(18\)% and the rest Skip breakfast. What percentage skip breakfast?
School transport: Bus \(44\)%, Car \(26\)%, Bicycle \(18\)% and the rest Walk. What percentage of students walk?
City waste composition: Organic \(42\)%, Recyclable \(28\)%, Plastic \(15\)% and the rest Hazardous. What percentage is Hazardous waste?
In a fitness centre, \(39\)% members use the gym, \(31\)% the pool, \(16\)% aerobics and the rest yoga. What percentage use yoga?
Company cafeteria usage: Lunch \(46\)%, Breakfast \(32\)%, Dinner \(14\)% and the rest Snacks only. What percentage eat only Snacks?
Magazine readership: News \(34\)%, Sports \(27\)%, Lifestyle \(21\)%, Technology \(10\)% and the rest Entertainment. What percentage read Entertainment?
Banking habits: \(41\)% use online banking, \(29\)% use ATMs, \(19\)% visit branches, and the rest use mobile apps. What percentage use mobile apps?
In a cinema hall, \(48\)% of tickets are booked online, \(31\)% at the counter and the rest by phone. What percentage are booked by phone?
In a neighbourhood, \(36\)% live in apartments, \(28\)% in villas, \(24\)% in townhouses and the rest in condos. What percentage live in condos?
A grocery store records purchases: Vegetables \(43\)%, Fruits \(32\)%, Dairy \(16\)% and the rest Packaged food. What percentage buy Packaged food?
A tech company’s staff: Development \(45\)%, Testing \(25\)%, Design \(18\)% and the rest Management. What percentage work in Management?
A country’s water usage: Domestic \(40\)%, Agricultural \(35\)%, Industrial \(15\)% and the rest Others. What percentage is Others?
An investment portfolio consists of Stocks \(55\)%, Bonds \(25\)% and the rest Cash. What percentage is Cash?
A smartphone’s battery drain: Screen \(45\)%, Apps \(30\)%, Stand-by \(15\)% and the rest System. What percentage is System?
Grade distribution in a class: A \(28\)%, B \(32\)%, C \(25\)%, D \(10\)% and the rest F. What percentage of students received grade F?
Tourism profile: Domestic \(60\)%, International \(25\)%, Pilgrimage \(10\)% and the rest Business travel. What percentage is Business travel?
